name: Systemic Sclerosis
definition: Systemic autoimmune connective-tissue disease characterized by vasculopathy, immune dysregulation and fibrosis affecting skin and internal organs.

investigations.principle: Autoantibodies and organ-directed testing guide diagnosis and severity assessment.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Twak/Rakta/Snayu fibrotic phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Systemic autoimmune connective-tissue disease characterized by vasculopathy, immune dysregulation and fibrosis affecting skin and internal organs.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for rapidly progressive weakness, respiratory/swallowing compromise, major vascular symptoms, suspected malignancy/pathological fracture, severe systemic illness or other listed red flags.
